teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Who does it?.
Welcome to today's lesson: Who does it?! Today we will practice how to use frequency adverbs (always, usually, sometimes, never).

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for Who does it?:
use frequency adverbs (always, usually, sometimes, never); talk about personal habits

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every_day

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Where do frequency adverbs go before main verbs?

options: at the end of the page

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: Who does the cooking at home? I usually cook, but my sister sometimes helps.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
I always wake up early. My brother usually drinks coffee. We never go to bed late on weekdays.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: State three things you always do and two things you never do during weekdays.
